description: This Java source file defines a final class 'RetrieveThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl' that extends an abstract builder class and implements 'RetrieveThingLiveCommandAnswerBuilder'. It provides a fluent API for creating responses for a 'RetrieveThingLiveCommand', including methods for building success and error responses, using an inner class 'ResponseFactoryImpl'. The class is part of a package managing live command responses for 'thing' retrieval in a signals/commands context within the Eclipse Ditto project.
